Cleanup observation failed: Bad state: Server instance changed during the run.
warmupFailure.interpretation: The 2048-device refinement failed during warmup. The sampled established population reached 1212; sampling returned an HTTP failure, and cleanup detected a changed server instance. Hundreds of stream ends were recorded. No idle/resume exercise or final exact verification completed. Subsequent cleanup drained the server to zero streams. The 1024-device source trial remains the verified idle/resume operating point.
warmupFailure.limits: The changed instance is observed, but its restart or replacement cause has not been established. Peak sampled cgroup memory was near the 512 MiB limit; sampling does not prove the maximum reached or an out-of-memory kill. The 1212 observed streams are an incomplete setup observation, not a qualified point.

closeFailure.interpretation: The 2048-device target was observed in warmup, idle exercise, and resumed-delivery probe, but the run failed its strict lifecycle gate with one unexpected stream end in the close phase. Preserve its delivery and verification observations separately from the unsuccessful overall verdict. Subsequent cleanup drained the server to zero streams; the 1024-device fully successful source trial remains the strict idle/resume selection.
closeFailure.limits: The close-phase failure does not prove inability to hold or deliver to 2048 established streams. Its initiating layer is unresolved, and a successful finite observation would still not establish a maximum or a long-term reliability guarantee.
